conflicts.permit: Certain respects your control over your information and, upon request, we will confirm whether we hold or are processing information that we have collected from you.
conflicts.prohibit: Any Customer Contact that wishes to exercise any of the rights mentioned above should directly contact our Customer.
conflicts.situation: When an individual Customer Contact requests Certain to confirm whether it holds or processes their personal data collected via the Certain Services.
conflicts.reason: The policy directly offers to handle access requests, yet immediately states that Certain has no direct control and that contacts must directly contact the Customer.

conflicts.permit: To establish and utilize, in conjunction with the information technology infrastructure, including data mining and other advanced analytical tools, in order to access, receive, and analyze data and information in furtherance of Certain’s business and market intelligence capabilities.
conflicts.prohibit: Certain processes Personal Data of Customer Contacts that has been collected by our Customers solely to provide the Certain Services that our Customers have contracted us to provide, as described below, or as required by law.
conflicts.situation: Certain analyzing Customer Contacts' personal data for Certain's own business and market intelligence capabilities rather than to provide the contracted services.
conflicts.reason: One clause restricts processing solely to providing contracted services or complying with law, while another permits data mining for Certain's own market intelligence without reconciliatory language.
